np2.verdict: NP2 target only. Warm CONT maps 4 refs to 4 distinct slots with zero confusion (25.59%); chunk-aligned cold PHASE_CHUNK maps C+A to same P0 with high confusion (61.72%, unconstrained); frame-only old PHASE intermediate (43.44%, MEE033 self-split); ORIG historical (58.49%, MEE035+MEE033 same P2). Historical ORIG/PHASE-vs-CONT comparison appended, not a causal claim. No general/model-fix claim, no product integration.
